integrity: A complete proof and a standard-library exact polynomial checker are embedded; the checker verifies algebraic identities but does not replace the conceptual geometric and Galois arguments.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic zero and the exact displayed rational canonical form of Wiman W160 only. Classical geometric W160 model and forty octads are explicitly credited to Edge 1969; the new claim is the arithmetic degrees (8,16,16) and minimal splitting field. Historic rational-descent priority cannot be independently certified.
title: Three arithmetic Weierstrass orbits of a rational form of Wiman’s \(W^{160}\)
